title: Teacher Parent Email Shield
oneLiner: Teachers convert angry parent emails about cheating, phones, or discipline into documented, policy-aligned replies they can defend.

sourceSignals.title: Teachers report angry parent emails and complaints around cheating/discipline while appreciation is rare
Small businesses adopted AI quickly but now face unexpected tool costs and human-touch backlash

stitchPrompt: Create a calm communication tool called “Teacher Parent Email Shield” for teachers responding to angry parent emails. Include an inbox, tone/severity tags, policy anchor selector, evidence log, warmth/firmness slider, reply draft, and admin escalation summary. Design direction: use the calm-consumer profile with reassuring warm neutrals, gentle accent color, clear next-step buttons, and supportive copy that reduces stress.
